system.description:
Battle Amp

Your body becomes thin and almost frail as you spread most of the water in your body into a mist of your absolute control.

Mist Mirage. You radiate a cloud of mist, filling a 30-foot radius, centered on you, that moves with you. Hostile creatures treat the affected area as difficult terrain and you are heavily obscured against hostile creatures until said creature is within 10 feet of you.

Where are You Looking?. The first time per turn when a creature attacks you, you can roll a d12. On a roll of 11 or less, their attack misses as it strikes a mirage. Once a creature misses in this way, reduce the roll needed to miss by 1 (10 or less > 9 or less > 8 or less, etc.).

Everywhere and No where. Attacks you make and jutsu you cast can originate from anywhere within your mist.
system.summary: A 30-foot mist moves with you: difficult terrain for foes, and you're heavily obscured beyond 10 feet. Attacks can miss on a d12, and your attacks can come from anywhere in the mist.

rules.text: Start: Bonus action and 4 Hydration, for your chosen Tidal State (chosen each long rest). Once per rest.
